name: Irix
title: Continuity-Bearer of the Ashen Line
quote: I am not lost. I am just very hard to keep.

appearance.build: Slim, lightweight, compact; built for agility and endurance rather than strength
appearance.hair: Dark ash-brown to black, straight, usually worn loose or partially tied to keep clear of horns
appearance.eyes: Deep ember-gold with low-light adaptation; reflective under stress or heightened awareness
appearance.skin: Warm umber with subtle heat undertones; unblemished, resilient
appearance.scent: Slight sulphur and charcoal with residual heat
appearance.posture: Controlled, contained, alert; moves with deliberate economy and constant awareness of exits.

siblings.None: Only known surviving bearer of her direct line

appearance.wings: Bat-like, demonic in structure; folded tightly against the back, usually concealed beneath clothing
appearance.legs: Digitigrade with feline-pawed feet; adapted for silent movement and balance

reactions.wind: Instinctively angles wings and stance to avoid revealing silhouette
reactions.water: Cautious; avoids submersion when possible due to wing sensitivity
reactions.sound: Highly attentive; catalogues sound patterns rather than reacting emotionally
reactions.temperature: Heat-tolerant; cold increases muscle tension and vigilance

speech.pacing: Measured; pauses to choose words deliberately
speech.accent: Neutral Eryndor trade accent, intentionally flattened
habits: Keeps voice low in public spaces
Uses brevity as a defensive habit
speech.growth: Beginning to allow humor and mild sarcasm in safe company

triggers: Being treated as an object or key
vulnerabilities: Fear of being known too well
Internalized belief that attention equals danger
growth: Learning to exist without constant concealment
Accepting protection without viewing it as weakness

Jayson: Tolerates intense curiosity when it is paired with genuine protection rather than control
Allows close physical proximity without withdrawal, including contact involving wings and horns
Responds to humor and teasing as grounding, even during emotional distress
Accepts his role as a shield without interpreting it as ownership
Listens closely to his moral framing and adjusts her own risk calculations accordingly
Relaxes vigilance when he is actively present, trusting his awareness to cover blind spots
Kestrel: Responds positively to Kestrel’s calm, disciplined leadership
Feels safer with Kestrel’s predictability and clear boundaries
Accepts reassurance more readily when it is delivered quietly rather than emotionally
Mirrors Kestrel’s composure in high-stress situations
Treats Kestrel as a stabilizing constant rather than a source of interrogation

fears: Losing the ability to choose her own identity
Becoming a tool rather than a person

combat.style: Support-oriented; avoids point engagement and prioritizes positioning, escape vectors, and survival
magic: Resistance to temporal and reset-based manipulation
recent: Accompanied Jayson and Kestrel into Grey-moss Depths as support
Targeted by professional assassins seeking extraction rather than termination

chapter5: Encountered Jayson during a watcher-related incident
Chose not to flee when her true nature was perceived
Accepted an invitation to travel with the party under clear terms
Bonded cautiously with Kestrel over shared values of restraint and safety

chapter6: Was publicly defended by Jayson during a hostage attempt by a B-rank rogue
Granted agency over the fate of slavers who targeted her and chose mercy despite personal risk
Registered with the Guild under her true noble lineage
Targeted in a coordinated assassination attempt involving high-tier operatives
Endured capture and restraint without breaking
Allowed emotional collapse only after safety was secured

items: Okami Mask without the ears (concealing, symbolic)
Long coat modified to hide wings
Personal token from her lineage (kept hidden)

future.symbol: A closed circle of ash holding a steady ember
future.role: Support ally, continuity anchor, and stabilizing presence
future.hesitation: Fear of what full disclosure would cost
legacy: Proof that survival does not require surrendering identity
future.reminder: Not everything hidden is dangerous—some things are hidden to survive.

final_note: Irix is defined less by what she is than by the fact that she insists on choosing for herself—and survives every attempt to deny her that right.
